contexts.text: Isaac represents spiritual love, which is of the internal man.
Therefore, by the seed of Isaac nothing else is signified than every man with whom there is spiritual love, or charity.
The celestial love represented by Abraham is as the father of the spiritual love represented by Isaac...
As by the Philistines are signified the Knowledges of faith... Isaac also sojourned there, by whom are represented the spiritual things of faith.
Isaac, in general, represents the Lord; in special, the spiritual man. AC 1409:3.
After the Lord's Divine Rational, represented by Isaac, had been born.

There are with every man an internal man, a rational man which is intermediate, and an external man. These with the Lord were represented by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob... the rational man by Isaac... AC 1893:2. AC 1893:end.
The Lord's Divine rational man is represented by Isaac; but the first rational man, which was made Divine, by Ishmael.
By Isaac is represented the Lord's interior man, or His Divine Rational.

After the Lord, by combats of temptations and victories, had... subjugated this Hereditary, and had vivified His Rational itself with Divine good, then it becomes Isaac, or is represented by Isaac, Ishmael being cast out of the house together with Hagar his mother.

This is evident from the signification of the hundred years which Abram had when Isaac was born to him, by whom is represented and signified the Lord's rational man which had been conjoined to His Internal, that is, to the Divine. AC 1988:3.
For a promise is now made concerning Isaac his son, by whom was to be represented the Lord's Divine Rational.
Abraham represents the Divine good, and Sarah the Divine truth, from which was to be born the Divine Rational, which is Isaac.

The second Rational, which is here treated of, is represented and signified by Isaac, who was born from Sarah... This Rational, which is represented by Isaac, is that which remains at home, because it is Divine.
Isaac was named from laughter; for Isaac means laughter. Illustrated.
Thou shalt call his name Isaac () = the Divine Rational... Isaac represents the Lord's rational man...
Isaac was named from laughter; and as laughter... = the affection of truth, which is of the Rational, it here = the Divine Rational.
By seed, here, are signified those who have the faith of love, that is, love to the Lord, consequently the celestial, or those who are of the Celestial Church, for it treats of the seed from Isaac.
The lower, or middle (celestial things of love), which are those of the Rational, are Isaac ().
Isaac = the Divine Rational. AC 2194:end. AC 2208. AC 2610. AC 2623.
(Abraham called the name of his son...) Isaac () = the Divine Rational.
Abraham circumcised Isaac his son () = the purification of the Rational.
When Isaac his son was born to him () = when the Lord's Rational was made Divine.
In the day when he weaned Isaac () = the state of separation (of the merely human Rational. See AC 2647.) Explained.
The son of this handmaid shall not inherit with my son, with Isaac () = that the merely human Rational could not have a common life with the Divine Rational itself, either as to truth or as to good.

My son, Isaac = the Divine Rational as to truth, which is my son; and as to good, which is Isaac That Isaac = the Divine Rational as to good, is evident from the signification of laughter, from which he was named, and which is the affection of truth, or the good of truth.
As by Isaac is represented the Lord's Divine Rational, the celestial are also signified by him, who are called heirs...

Because in Isaac shall thy seed be called () = that from the Lord's Divine Human is all salvation for those who are in good. Isaac = the Divine Rational, thus the Divine Human; for the human begins in the inmost of the Rational.

Isaac () = the quality of (the Divine Rational); namely, that it is the good of truth and the truth of good; that is, the Divine marriage as to the Human of the Lord. This is evident from the name Isaac.
Offer (Isaac) for a burnt-offering () = that He should sanctify Himself with the Divine. Explained. AC 2777.
And Isaac his son () = the Divine Rational begotten by Himself.

I and the boy will go even yonder = the Divine Rational in a state of truth girded for the most grievous and inmost combats of temptations... Isaac = the Divine Rational; but as he is here not called Isaac, nor my son, as before, but the boy, it = the Divine Rational in such a state... AC 2795:2, Explained.
Concerning His Divine Human, which is represented by Isaac...
He put (the woods of the burnt-offering) upon Isaac () = that the merit of justice was adjoined to the Divine Rational. Explained.

Isaac said to Abraham his father, and he said, My father; and he said. Behold I, my son () = a colloquy of the Lord from the love of Divine truth with Divine good. Isaac the son = Divine truth... Hence it is evident that it is a colloquy of the Lord with His Father.
He bound Isaac his son () = the state of the Divine Rational thus as to truth about to undergo the last degrees of temptation... Isaac the son = the Lord's Divine Rational; here, as to truth.

Send not forth thy hand to the boy () = that he should not admit temptation any further into the truth Divine which belonged to the Rational... The boy, or Isaac, here, = the Rational as to truth Divine, into which temptations were admitted.

And hast not withheld thy son, thine only one, from Me () = the unition of the Human with the Divine through the last of temptation. Thy son, namely, Isaac, = the Divine Rational, or the Divine Human; for this begins in the Rational.
Under Hittite, see this reference.
Isaac (in ) = the good of the Rational.

That thou take not a woman for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite () = that the Divine Rational was not to be conjoined with any affection which disagrees with truth... My son, namely, Isaac, = the Lord's Divine Rational. AC 3154:3.
Isaac and Rebekah represented (the Divine good and the Divine truth) in the Lord's Divine Human.
The Lord's Divine Rational was born from the Divine truth itself conjoined with Divine good. The Divine Rational is Isaac...

Isaac came from coming to Beer-lahai-roi () = Divine rational good born from the Divine truth Itself. Isaac = the Lord's Divine Rational, here, as to Divine good there, because truth Divine, which is represented by Rebekah, had not as yet been called forth out of the Natural...
And Isaac went forth to meditate in the field () = the state of the Rational in good. Isaac = the Divine Rational.
At the perception of the rational good which is represented by Isaac Signified.
And Isaac was comforted after his mother () = a new state... The new state is the state of the glorification of the Rational, as before in respect to good, so now in respect to truth...
That there commenced the representative of the Lord by Isaac and Ishmael. Treated of.

Abraham gave all things which he had to Isaac () = in the supreme sense, all Divine things in the Divine Rational; and, in the relative sense, the celestial things of love in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom. Explained.

There are two things which properly constitute the human: the Rational, and the Natural. The Rational of the Lord is represented by Isaac, and His Natural by Jacob. The Lord made both Divine The way in which He made the Rational Divine is contained in these things which are said about Isaac...
For by Isaac, in the relative sense, is signified the Celestial Kingdom...
He sent them from with Isaac his son () = a distinction and separation of the spiritual from the celestial.
And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him () = that the representative of the Lord was now taken up by Isaac and Ishmael.
God blessed Isaac his son () = the beginning of the representation by Isaac.
Isaac dwelt with Beer-lahai-roi () = the Lord's Divine Rational in Divine light. Explained.
Abraham begat Isaac () = from the Divine Itself the Divine Rational.
And Isaac was a son of forty years () = ... that the Lord made His Rational Divine even as to truth by the combats of temptations, thus of His Own power.

Isaac prayed to Jehovah () = the communication of the Divine which is the Son with the Divine which is the Father... Isaac = the Divine Rational. The Divine which is the Son is Isaac, or the Rational when truth has been conjoined with it.
Isaac loved Esau because venison was in his mouth () = that the Divine good of the Divine Rational loved the good of truth. Isaac = the Lord's Divine Rational as to Divine good.

Isaac went to Abimelech the king of the Philistines, to Gerar () = the doctrinal things of faith. Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational. References. That Isaac = the Lord's Divine Rational as to Divine good; (References.) and also as to Divine truth which IS represented by the marriage of Isaac with Rebekah; (References.) thus by Isaac is here represented the Lord as to Divine truth conjoined with the Divine good of the Rational; for Rebekah was with Isaac and was called his sister... Hence it is evident that (the above words) = that the doctrine of faith from the Lord was looking to rational things.
Isaac dwelt in Gerar () = the Lord's state as to the things of faith relatively to the rational things were to be adjoined... Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational...
For by Isaac, who here is me, is represented the Divine good of the Lord's Rational. Treated of. AC 3390.
Behold Isaac was laughing with Rebekah his woman () = that Divine good was present in Divine truth, or that Divine good was adjoined to Divine truth Isaac = the Divine good of the Lord's Rational.
And Abimelech called Isaac, and said () = the Lord's perception from doctrine... Isaac = Lord's Divine Rational.
To approach to Divine truth and to Divine good, which are represented by Isaac and Rebekah.
Isaac sowed in that land () = interior truths, which are from the Lord, appearing to the Rational.
And Abimelech said to Isaac () = the Lord's perception concerning that doctrine... Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational.
And Isaac departed thence () = that the Lord left interior truths... Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational. Explained.

Isaac returned and digged again the wells of waters which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father () = that the Lord opened those truths which had been with the Ancients. Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational.
And Isaac sent them away, and they went from with him in peace () = that they were content.
And the servants of Isaac came () = rational things. Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine Rational.
From the things which precede it is evident what of the Lord is here represented by Isaac, namely, the Word as to its internal sense...
They were bitterness of spirit to Isaac and Rebekah () = that thence at first was grief... Isaac and Rebekah = the Lord's Divine Rational as to Divine good and Divine truth.
From the Divine good of the Divine Rational, which is represented by Isaac...
In the internal sense... Isaac = the rational mind as to the good which is of the will...
The good of the Rational which is represented by Isaac...
For Isaac represents the Rational as to good... AC 3590.
Isaac his father answered and said to him () = perception concerning natural good, that it would be made Divine. Isaac = the Lord's Divine Rational as to the Divine good there.
Rebekah said to Isaac () = the Lord's perception from Divine truth. Explained.
Isaac called to Jacob () = the perception of the quality as to the good of truth from the Lord... Isaac = the Lord as to the Divine good of the Divine Rational. AC 3679.
Evil in the eyes of Isaac his father () = not conducing to conjunction... with the good of the Rational, which is Isaac.
The God of Isaac () = the Lord as to the Divine Human. Explained. AC 4252.
The internal sense of the Word... may be said to be represented by Isaac, but the supreme sense by Abraham.
That Isaac = the Divine Rational as to good. References.
The Rational is represented by Isaac and Rebekah.

To come to Isaac his father to the Land of Canaan () = to conjoin with the Divine good of the Rational, in order that the Human might be made Divine. Isaac = the Divine Rational; and, in special, the Divine good of the Rational. References.
Abraham together with Isaac represents the Divine good which inflows directly.
The Dread of Isaac () = the Divine Human. Explained. AC 4208.
It was the descendants of Jacob in special who represented the Church; but not those of Isaac in special; for the descendants of Isaac were not only from Jacob, but also from Esau...
Progress towards interior things still further, to where the Rational is, is described by... the coming of the sons of Jacob to Isaac ().
Isaac = the good of the Rational. References.

The Land which I have given to Abraham and Isaac... ()... Abraham and Isaac = the Divine of the Lord; Abraham, the Divine itself, and Isaac, the Divine Human; in special, the Lord's Divine Rational, References.
Isaac = the Rational, or Intellectual. The coming of Jacob with his sons to Isaac... - this conjunction with the Intellectual.
It treats of the conjunction of the Divine Natural with the Divine Rational, which conjunction is represented by the coming of Jacob to Isaac... AC 4612. AC 4614.
Where there sojourned Abraham and Isaac () = the Divine life together... Isaac = His Divine Rational.
The days of Isaac were () = the state of the Divine Rational now.
And Isaac expired and died () = exsuscitation in the Divine Natural. Explained.
Isaac represents this rational good.
Isaac, who is here his father, = the Lord's Divine Rational as to good.
Isaac represents the Divine Intellectual.
By Isaac is represented the Lord as to the Divine Rational.
Isaac, in the supreme sense, = the Lord's Divine Rational or Intellectual. References. AC 6003.
Isaac chose a god who was called Pachad, or Dread.
Hence by... Isaac is represented the Spiritual with man.
In the supreme sense... Isaac = His Divine Rational, thus the Internal Human... But in the representative sense... Isaac = internal truth. Explained. AC 6284.
Isaac = the Interior which is under the Inmost.
Isaac = the Spiritual in that Human.
By Isaac () is represented the Lord.
To drop against the house of Isaac () = to charge those of the Church who are in the falsities of evil... The house of Isaac = the Church...
The Divine Spiritual which Isaac signifies, is the Divine truth.
By Isaac is meant the Lord as to the Divine Spiritual of the Church... Therefore... by the seed of Isaac is signified Divine truth spiritual...
